class <Req> Requirements

class GravSci_Reqs extending Requirements {
  angle_SpacecraftEarthSun:Real
  latitude_Spacecraft:Real
  longitude_Spacecraft:Real

  req ValidAngle: 2E1 <= angle_SpacecraftEarthSun && angle_SpacecraftEarthSun <= 1.8E2

  req ValidLatitude: ((-4E1) <= latitude_Spacecraft) && (latitude_Spacecraft <= 6E1)
}

class Telecom_Reqs extending Requirements {
  isDSNsatisfieable:Bool

  req ValidGSCapability: isDSNsatisfieable = true
}

class Instrument_Reqs extending Requirements {
  steradians:Real
  YZwidecvrg:Real
  YZorthocvrg:Real
  measurement_accy:Real
  interval:Real
  GSdatacollect:Bool
  GSsignal:Bool

  req ValidGSMeasurementPointing: 0E0 <= steradians && steradians <= 9.7E1 && 2.7E2 <= YZwidecvrg && YZwidecvrg <= 3.6E2 && 2E1 <= YZorthocvrg && YZorthocvrg <= 3.6E2

  req (0E0 < interval && interval <= 6E1) => (0E0 < measurement_accy && measurement_accy <= 1E-1)

  req ValidGSdatacollection: GSdatacollect = true

  req ValidGSdatacollection: GSsignal = true
}

class Radio_Reqs_A extending Requirements {
  GS_uplink_pt_no:Real
  GS_boresight_pointing_error:Real
  DSN:Int = 34
  fanbeam_boresight_alignment:Real
  xband_downlink_pt_no:Real
  GS_downlink_pt_no:Real

  req ValidUplinkPtNo: 2.5E1 <= GS_uplink_pt_no && GS_uplink_pt_no <= 5E1

  req ValidBoresightPointingError: 0E0 <= GS_boresight_pointing_error && GS_boresight_pointing_error <= 8.7E0

  req ValidBoresightAlignment: 0E0 <= fanbeam_boresight_alignment && fanbeam_boresight_alignment <= 2.5E-1

  req ValidPowerNoise: 0E0 <= xband_downlink_pt_no && xband_downlink_pt_no <= 1E1 && DSN = 34

  req ValidDownlink_pt_no: 0E0 <= GS_downlink_pt_no && GS_downlink_pt_no <= 1E1 && DSN = 34
}

class Radio_Reqs_B extending Requirements {
  DSN:Int = 34
  twowayDoppleraccuracy:Real
  twowayDoppler_PcNo:Real
  GravSciXband_Coherency:Bool
  TelecomTurnaroundGS:Bool
  GS_EIRP:Real
  GSA_GT:Real

  req Valid2WayDopplerAccuracy: 0E0 <= twowayDoppleraccuracy && twowayDoppleraccuracy <= 1E-1 && 1E1 < twowayDoppler_PcNo && twowayDoppler_PcNo <= 2E1

  req ValidGSXband_Coherency: (GravSciXband_Coherency = true)

  req ValidTelecomTurnaroundGS: (TelecomTurnaroundGS = true)

  req ValidGS_EIRP: 4.937E1 < GS_EIRP && GS_EIRP <= 1E2 && DSN = 34

  req ValidGSA_GT: 2.12E1 < GSA_GT && GSA_GT <= 4E1
}

class RadioGravSci_Reqs extending Requirements {
  range:Real
  altitude:Real
  k2accuracy:Real
  isoccultatedbyearth:Bool
  europa:Europa

  req ValidAltitude: 2.5E1 < altitude && altitude <= 1E2

  req Validk2accuracy: 0 <= k2accuracy && k2accuracy <= 5E-2

  req 0E0 < range && (range <= 1.8E1 * europa.radius) => isoccultatedbyearth = false
}

fun squared2(x:Real) : Real
{
  x * x
}

class Body {
  mass:Real
  radius:Real
  sundistance:Real
  gravity:Real
  density:Real

  fun TwoBodyGravity1(body1:Body,body2:Body) : Real
  {
    6.74E-11 * body1.mass * body2.mass / squared2(body1.sundistance - body2.sundistance)
  }
}

class Jupiter extending Body {

  req mass = 1.898E27

  req radius = 6.9911E4

  req sundistance = 7.785E8

  req gravity = 2.479E1

  req density = 1.33E0
}

class Europa extending Body {

  req mass = 4.7998E22

  req radius = 1.5608E3

  req gravity = 1.314E0

  req density = 3.013E0
}

class Spacecraft extending Body {

  req mass = 3.1E3

  req gravity = 0E0

  req density = 2.7E0
}

class Earth extending Body {

  req mass = 5.972E24

  req radius = 6.371E3

  req sundistance = 1.4966E8

  req gravity = 9.807E0

  req density = 5.51E0
}

class Sun extending Body {

  req mass = 1.989E30

  req radius = 695800

  req sundistance = 0E0

  req gravity = 2.802E1

  req density = 1.41E0
}

assoc JupiterTwoBody {
  source jupiter:Jupiter
  target body:Body[0..*]
}

JupiterMain:Jupiter

EuropaMain:Europa

SpacecraftMain:Spacecraft

EarthMain:Earth

SunMain:Sun

Jupiter_Europa:JupiterTwoBody = JupiterTwoBody(jupiter :: JupiterMain,body :: EuropaMain)

Jupiter_Spacecraft:JupiterTwoBody = JupiterTwoBody(jupiter :: JupiterMain,body :: SpacecraftMain)

Jupiter_Earth:JupiterTwoBody = JupiterTwoBody(jupiter :: JupiterMain,body :: EarthMain)

Jupiter_Sun:JupiterTwoBody = JupiterTwoBody(jupiter :: JupiterMain,body :: SunMain)

GravSci_ReqsMain:GravSci_Reqs

Telecom_ReqsMain:Telecom_Reqs

Instrument_ReqsMain:Instrument_Reqs

Radio_Reqs_AMain:Radio_Reqs_A

Radio_Reqs_BMain:Radio_Reqs_B

RadioGravSci_ReqsMain:RadioGravSci_Reqs

BodiesOnSameSideOfSun:Bool

req Aignment1: BodiesOnSameSideOfSun = true

req EuropaMain.sundistance = JupiterMain.sundistance - 6.079E5

req SpacecraftMain.sundistance = (EuropaMain.sundistance - 1.5608E3 - RadioGravSci_ReqsMain.altitude)

req Distance: JupiterMain.sundistance > EuropaMain.sundistance && EuropaMain.sundistance > SpacecraftMain.sundistance && SpacecraftMain.sundistance > EarthMain.sundistance && EarthMain.sundistance > SunMain.sundistance

JupiterEarth_Gravity:Real

JupiterEuropa_Gravity:Real

JupiterSun_Gravity:Real

JupiterMass:Real = JupiterMain.mass

EarthMass:Real = EarthMain.mass

EuropaMass:Real = EuropaMain.mass

SpacecraftMass:Real = SpacecraftMain.mass

SunMass:Real = SunMain.mass

JupiterSundistance:Real = JupiterMain.sundistance

EarthSundistance:Real = EarthMain.sundistance

EuropaSundistance:Real = EuropaMain.sundistance

SpacecraftSundistance:Real = SpacecraftMain.sundistance

SunSundistance:Real = SunMain.sundistance

req JupiterEuropa_Gravity = 6.74E-11 * JupiterMass * EuropaMass / squared2(JupiterSundistance - EuropaSundistance)

req JupiterSun_Gravity = 6.74E-11 * JupiterMass * SunMass / squared2(JupiterSundistance - SunSundistance)
